name: UNITRAD
recent: Unitrade Industries Berhad 近期通过持股60%的间接子公司 Winnson Ecotech 与芬兰 Molok OY 签署技术转让与授权制造协议，并获授权在柔佛本地生产 Molok 半地下垃圾收集容器。公司同时与 Blue Marble Sdn Bhd 签署分销协议，配合柔佛州智能深埋收集系统项目。最新季度（2026年6月30日止）营收与净利均较上季及去年同期增长。
notable: 间接持股60%的子公司 Winnson Ecotech 与 Molok OY 签署技术转让与授权制造协议，在柔佛本地生产 Molok 垃圾收集容器。
公司与 Blue Marble Sdn Bhd 签署分销协议，配合柔佛州智能深埋收集系统项目。
2026年9月2日举行的第五届常年股东大会通过全部决议。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为 MYR 418.78 million，环比增长2.5%，同比增长4.3%；净利为 MYR 10.86 million，环比增长502.4%，同比增长68.5%；净利率为2.6%，高于上一季度的0.4%。

recent_en: Unitrade Industries Berhad recently signed a technology transfer and licensed manufacturing agreement with Finland's Molok OY through its 60%-owned indirect subsidiary Winnson Ecotech, securing rights to locally manufacture Molok semi-underground waste collection containers for Johor. It also entered a distribution agreement with Blue Marble Sdn Bhd under Johor's smart deep collection system project. Revenue and net profit for the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026 rose both quarter-on-quarter and year-on-year.
notable_en: Indirect 60%-owned subsidiary Winnson Ecotech signed a technology transfer and licensed manufacturing agreement with Molok OY to locally produce Molok waste collection containers in Johor.
The company signed a distribution agreement with Blue Marble Sdn Bhd for Johor's smart deep collection system project.
All resolutions were passed at the Fifth Annual General Meeting held on 2 September 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 418.78 million, up 2.5% quarter-on-quarter and 4.3% year-on-year; net profit was MYR 10.86 million, up 502.4% quarter-on-quarter and 68.5% year-on-year; net margin was 2.6%, higher than 0.4% in the previous quarter.
